name: adr_ops
description: Create and verify Living Architecture Decision Records (L-ADRs). Tracks code symbol references with SHA-256 hashes to detect when architecture decisions drift from active codebase implementations. Actions: create_adr, check_drift, list_adrs.

action.description: Operation to perform: create_adr (scaffold a new living ADR with symbol hashes), check_drift (scan existing ADRs and verify if referenced code symbols have changed), list_adrs (list all ADRs and their status).

adr_number.description: ADR number, e.g. '001' or '002' (required for create_adr).

title.description: ADR title, e.g. 'Use Redis for Distributed Caching' (required for create_adr).

decision.description: The decision reached and rationale (for create_adr).

symbols.description: List of symbol references to anchor and hash, formatted as '@symbol:path/to/file.ext:SymbolName' (for create_adr).

execution_dir.description: Optional project execution directory path (e.g. /opt/data/workspace/my-project). Defaults to finding .planning directory under workspace.
